senses.gloss: Ar. אוּדְרָא ed. m. (אדד, אדר, v. אָדַר: Syr. אודדא; cmp. אַדְדָא, אַדְרָא as to dial. var.) upholsterer’s stuffing material, tow-cotton, wool.
units: Sabb. 48ᵃ לאהדורי א׳ (Ms. M. אוּדְדֵי Pl.) to put the stuffing back into the mattress.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 58a:9">B. Bath. 58ᵃ</cite> <he>חביתא דא׳</he> (Mss. <he>דאודד׳</he>) a vessel full of stuffings (enigmatical for bolsters).
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 28b">Ab. Zar. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>א׳ דנדא וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>ארדא דנורא</he>) tow cotton which has been dyed but not combed.

<cite ref="Kiddushin 12a:14">Kidd. 12ᵃ</cite> <he>זוודא דאורדי</he> (corr. acc.) a bundle of tow-cotton. [Cmp. <cite ref="P00200"><he>עוּדְדָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="P00205"><he>עוּדְרָא</he></cite>; also <cite ref="A01602"><he>אִירָּא</he></cite> a. <cite ref="A01166"><he>אִידָּן</he></cite>; v. Fuerst, H. Dict. lit. <cite ref="T00000"><he>ר</he></cite>.]
